measurement_gates.fixture: tb_llm_operators head operator: 4096 rows, llm_parameter_ram five-edge response, real llm_math
measurement_gates.bandwidth: 4.125 parameter words (1,056 bits) per row; 16,896 words = 528 KiB per head pass; one 256-bit word per clock = 3.2 GB/s at 100 MHz

definitions.rows_in_flight: rows whose first weight word was requested and not yet selected at epilogue stage 5, sampled every H_STREAM_WAIT cycle; engine fixture counts to retirement
definitions.port_idle: RUN cycles with rows left to request and no request
definitions.read_credit_stalls: port_idle cycles with eight reads outstanding
definitions.epilogue_stalls: a retired row arriving while epilogue stage 0 or a linear feed is busy
